front: What is an indigenous knowledge system?
back: Knowledge, skills and beliefs built up by a community over generations about its environment, medicine and survival, and passed on by example and word of mouth.

front: Why were many San pushed into drier regions?
back: Bantu-speaking farmers took over fertile, well-watered land that hunting bands depended on, although trade and intermarriage also took place.

front: Why is San rock art important to historians?
back: It shows animals, people and ritual scenes, so it is evidence of San beliefs and daily life, though it is hard to date and interpret.
